verdict.rationale: Close's pricing page lists 'Automated workflows' and 'Use Chloe in Workflows', which suggests a first-party automation feature. There is no documentation of event triggers, rule conditions or resulting actions. Webhooks and the event log are developer building blocks for streaming events out, not product-side rules, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented event-based triggers, rule/condition definition, the catalog of actions, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
